channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan delays UAE visit, due in Ethiopia for talks
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has postponed his planned Feb. 16 visit to the United Arab Emirates and is expected to travel to Ethiopia on Feb. 17 for a one-day visit aimed at strengthening bilateral relations and signing new cooperation agreements.

item.title: New courthouse offices to review hotline complaints over legal delays
item.description: New offices to be set up in courthouses across Türkiye will evaluate complaints submitted through a new judicial hotline aimed at reducing delays in legal proceedings, local media said on Feb. 16.

item.title: Türkiye cocoa exports hit all-time high of $1.7 billion in 2025
item.description: Türkiye has set a new record in cocoa exports, despite the crop not being cultivated domestically due to climate conditions.

item.title: Turkish cosmetics sector rides ‘Turkish Beauty’ wave to global growth
item.description: Türkiye’s cosmetics industry is reaping the rewards of its “Turkish Beauty” strategy, launched in 2006, with exports reaching $2.33 billion in 2025—a year-on-year increase of 11.8 percent.

item.title: Türkiye seeks to expand sports tourism beyond football
item.description: Türkiye is taking significant steps to diversify its sports tourism sector, moving beyond football to embrace cycling, winter sports, and other disciplines.

item.title: Oil in spotlight as Trump's Iran warning rattles sleepy markets
item.description: Oil prices were in focus Tuesday as U.S. President Donald Trump ramped up threats towards Iran, shaking up markets subdued by holidays in Asia and the United States.

item.title: Lebanon says army to take at least 4 months for next stage of Hezbollah disarmament plan
item.description: Lebanon's government said Monday that the army would need at least four months to implement the second phase of the military's plan to disarm militant group Hezbollah in the country's south.

item.title: Israeli approval of West Bank land registration draws outrage
item.description: Israel's government has approved a process to register land in the West Bank as "state property", drawing condemnation from Arab nations and critics who said it would accelerate annexation of the Palestinian territory.

item.title: Moscow, Kiev set for Geneva peace talks amid Russian attacks
item.description: Russian and Ukrainian delegations are set for another round of talks on Tuesday in Geneva as part of the latest fraught push by the United States to end the four-year war.

item.title: Iran, United States set for new talks in Geneva
item.description: President Donald Trump warned Iran of potential consequences should it fail to strike a deal with the United States, as negotiators prepare for the latest round of talks in Geneva on Tuesday.
